title: Cross-Process Outcome Ledger + Neural Feedback Bus
brief: Close architect risk #1 (outcome data starvation). Every print-to-program pipeline run, consensus decision, and machine job must emit a structured CrossProcessOutcomeEvent that lands in CrossProcessOutcomeStore. Add a feedback bus so downstream learning engines (CrossProcessNeuralLearningEngine, BayesianCalibrate, LoRA trainers) subscribe instead of poll.

shipped.design: emitP2POutcome({engineName, domain, pipelineStage, success, jobId?, summary?, warnings?, scaffolded?, note?}) → outcomeCaptureBusEngine.record(kind='cross_process_stage_complete', source='system'). Helper sanitizes summary: scalar-only (number|boolean|string≤256), snake_case keys only, NaN/Infinity/objects/arrays dropped with stderr breadcrumb. Caller summary namespaced under actual.summary (collision-proof with helper-controlled actual.success). Severity = info on success, medium on failure. v1.1.0 schema auto-stamped via bus pickSchemaVersion. Fire-and-forget contract: bus.record() returns ok:false on schema-fail (no throw), helper additionally try/catches for defense-in-depth.

units.title: CrossProcessOutcomeStore replay capability — reproduce last 100 jobs
exit_conditions: store.replay(limit) returns ordered events
store.replayJob(jobId) returns all events for a single job in order
store.replaySince(timestamp) returns events after a cutoff
Tests: write 200 events, replay last 100 returns correct slice; replay by jobId returns full chain; replaySince filters correctly
units.description: Read-side API for the ledger. Used by learning engines and audit dashboards. JSONL streaming reader; never load full ledger into memory.

units.title: Neural feedback bus — pub/sub for outcome events
exit_conditions: FeedbackBusEngine.subscribe(domain, callback) registers listeners
FeedbackBusEngine.publish(event) fires all matching subscribers async
Subscribers: CrossProcessNeuralLearningEngine, BayesianCalibrationEngine, CAMLoRAAdapterTrainerEngine wired
Tests: subscribe + publish round-trip; subscriber error does not prevent other subscribers; publish to non-existent domain is no-op
E2E: simulate a mill job, verify ALL 3 subscribers get the event
units.description: In-process event emitter (Node EventEmitter). Lightweight — not a queue. Future MS may add durability. Subscribers must be idempotent; bus does not retry.

acceptance: Every P2P run writes a structured outcome event; replay reproduces last 100 jobs in order; 3 learning engines receive events via feedback bus; schemaVersion gate live.

risks.description: Engine emission adds latency; mitigation = fire-and-forget Promise.resolve, never await
Ledger grows unbounded; mitigation = rotation at 100MB, archived to .gz
Subscriber crash propagates; mitigation = try/catch around each invocation in publish loop
